prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a production atlas on true transparent background: four columns by two rows, eight equal cells, generous transparent gutters, no grid or captions. Bottom row: the corresponding four isolated small gray flat-lever valve/neck connector fittings, one per cell, matching the top-row installed valve. Each bottom-row fitting has only the actual short valve, small lever, neck seat/seal, and hose outlet; no label or decorative pedestal. Keep the drawing's warm restrained material rendering. Bodies are complete and centered without clipping; four same-scale bodies, four same-scale fittings. Empty/full need no visual distinction. DO NOT add handles, protective hoops, gauges, brass, nameplates, feet, rings, crates, stands, decorative hardware, backgrounds or shadows-as-floor. Genuine alpha transparency.
